map.由数据集与批次计算每轮训练步数。: Compute the number of training steps per epoch from the dataset and batch size.
map.多卡数据并行时，全局批量 = 单卡批量 × 卡数，每卡步数不变但每步实际看到的样: With multi-GPU data parallelism, global batch = per-GPU batch x GPU count; per-GPU steps stay the same but each step sees samples multiplied by the GPU count. To keep equivalent training intensity after scaling up, raise the learning rate or add epochs proportionally.
map.分布式下每卡步数不变，总样本覆盖相同。: Under distribution, per-GPU steps are unchanged and total sample coverage is the same.
map.每轮步数 steps=⌈数据集样本数/batch_size⌉，决定单轮迭代次数。: Steps per epoch = ceil(dataset size / batch_size), determining the number of iterations per epoch.
map.分布式下每卡步数=⌈N/(batch×world_size)⌉，注意尾批与丢弃策: Under distribution per-GPU steps = ceil(N / (batch x world_size)); mind the tail batch and drop strategy.
map.步数×单步耗时≈单轮时长，是训练排期与进度估算的基础。: Steps x per-step time ~ epoch duration, the basis for training scheduling and progress estimation.
map.N=50000, batch=64 → steps=⌈50000/64⌉=782: N=50000, batch=64 -> steps=ceil(50000/64)=782 steps/epoch. With 4 GPUs data-parallel and per-GPU batch=64, each GPU does 782 steps (total samples unchanged); the effective batch=256 converges faster.
map.分布式每卡步数变少吗？: Do per-GPU steps decrease under distribution?
map.若每卡 batch 不变，每卡处理的样本数减少，步数按每卡样本算会减少；总计算量: If per-GPU batch stays the same, each GPU processes fewer samples, so steps counted per GPU decrease; total compute is unchanged, only parallel-accelerated, and the effective batch grows.
map.尾批怎么影响步数？: How does the tail batch affect steps?
map.向上取整已含尾批(不足 batch 的余量)。若启用 drop_last 则步数: Ceiling already includes the tail batch (the remainder below one batch). If drop_last is enabled, steps = floor(N / batch), dropping one incomplete batch, which must be handled in the metrics.
map.每卡训练步数（本页代码口径）：每卡步数=⌈数据集样本数÷批次大小⌉（向上取整）；: Training steps per GPU (this page's code): steps per GPU=⌈dataset samples÷batch size⌉ (rounded up); samples per step=batch size×GPU count. Validation: no strict checks; empty values count as 0; a non-finite result prompts "Some results are undefined (zero denominator or empty input)". Grading: no fixed tiers; the remainder samples are folded into the last step.
map.步数判读（与上式互补）：步数=⌈数据÷批次⌉ 仅由数据规模与批次决定、与卡数无关: Step-count interpretation (complementary to the formula above): steps=⌈data÷batch⌉ depends only on data size and batch, not on GPU count — GPUs only change per-step throughput (samples per step=batch×GPUs), and both are shown side by side. Validation: same as above; empty values count as 0. Grading: no fixed tiers; a larger batch reduces steps proportionally, and doubling the data doubles the steps.
